# Maverick City Builders (MCB)

> General contractor based at 1171 Main St, Lancaster, Massachusetts 01523, serving Worcester County and Central Massachusetts. Kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, home additions, deck building, carpentry and built-ins, interior and exterior painting, general renovations, building restoration and water damage restoration. Owner: Douglas Mourao. Phone: (508) 656-7436. Email: douglas@mcitybuilders.com. Every job starts with a written estimate that itemizes scope, materials and exclusions, then a written contract before work begins.

## Services
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://mcitybuilders.com/kitchen-remodeling): Cosmetic refresh $16,000–$28,000; mid-range full remodel $35,000–$65,000; full gut $65,000–$110,000
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://mcitybuilders.com/bathroom-remodeling): Cosmetic or powder room $8,000–$16,000; standard remodel $16,000–$28,000; layout change $32,000–$60,000; primary suite $70,000–$125,000
- [Deck Building](https://mcitybuilders.com/deck-building): Pressure-treated 16x20 $10,000–$18,000; composite 16x20 $18,000–$35,000
- [Interior Painting](https://mcitybuilders.com/interior-painting): Single room $1,200–$3,000; whole interior $6,000–$50,000
- [Exterior Painting](https://mcitybuilders.com/exterior-painting): Full exterior repaint $6,500–$16,000
- [Carpentry](https://mcitybuilders.com/carpentry): Trim, built-ins, framing and rot repair
- [General Renovations](https://mcitybuilders.com/general-renovations): Whole-house remodels and additions
- [Water Damage Restoration](https://mcitybuilders.com/water-damage-restoration): Rebuild after mitigation
- [Building Restoration](https://mcitybuilders.com/building-restoration)
- [All Services](https://mcitybuilders.com/services)

Prices are the same in every town; what varies is the age and condition of the house.

## Service Area
- [Areas We Serve](https://mcitybuilders.com/areas-we-serve): Lancaster, Sterling, Clinton, Bolton, Berlin, Harvard, Hudson, Leominster, Fitchburg, Worcester, Shrewsbury, Princeton, Marlborough, Stow, Boxborough, Acton, Concord, Sudbury and surrounding Central Massachusetts towns
